sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pest Control is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come in, have a seat. You know how angry the local scum makes me, especially the damn looters, I can't stand them. Somebody steals from others to survive, but some do it for profit, and there are especially plenty of the latter ones in Tarkov. Take the military base, for example. I've been there before this whole conflict, it was such a beautiful sight: everything is clean, in order, the ground is almost glittering under the sun. And now the whole place is filled with all sorts of scum and marauders. I have a request for you: go there and let those looters know that you have to stay human in any situation."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 10 Scavs around the main barracks on Reserve

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Is it done? The air almost seems fresher now. It's a pity we couldn't get those looters' heads on straight in another way."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill 10 Scavs around of the black and white pawn barrack buildings. Getting tagged and cursed on purpose can help with getting Scavs in the quest area.
